title: Sweet and Sour Rice Pot
description: Chicken, red pepper, pineapple, Tenderstem broccoli and water chestnuts simmered with rice in a homemade sweet and sour sauce.
ingredients: 3 skinless chicken breasts (total weight about 500g/1lb 2oz), finely chopped
1 red pepper, deseeded and very finely chopped
2 canned pineapple rings (total weight about 65g/2.5oz), very finely chopped
800ml (1 pint 9fl oz) hot chicken stock, plus extra if needed
TO SERVE: spring onions finely chopped, red chilli finely chopped
SAUCE: 2 tbsp tomato ketchup, 2 tbsp white rice vinegar, 1 tbsp light soy sauce, 2 tsp light brown sugar
steps: Mix together all the ingredients for the sauce in a small bowl.

Spray a deep, nonstick flameproof casserole dish (with a lid) with oil. Fry the onion and chicken for 8 minutes. Season, then add the pepper, garlic and sweet and sour sauce. Stir in the rice, then add the pineapple, broccoli, water chestnuts and hot stock.
Place the lid on the pan, and gently simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove the lid from the pan and simmer with the lid off for 2 minutes. Check that the rice is fully cooked (if not, allow it to simmer for longer, adding more stock if necessary).
Place the lid back on, remove the pan from the heat and leave to stand for 5 minutes. Serve scattered with spring onions and chilli.
notes: You can double up on the batch of sweet and sour sauce and reserve half to drizzle over the rice dish when you serve it. Bring it to the boil in a small saucepan, add 2 tablespoons of water and simmer for a couple of minutes before serving alongside the rice pot.
